evals.name: plan-to-cards-with-skills
evals.prompt: /andon put the plan in docs/plans/login-revamp.md on the board for the Web team
evals.expected_output: Triggers andon. Writes a cards.json with one card per Key Feature, each naming its skills; runs push_cards.py as a dry run; shows the list (title, team › project, recipe, skills) and waits for a yes before --send. Every card's notes open with the Skills to use block.

evals.name: status-from-any-harness
evals.prompt: what's the status of the login cards on andon? anything waiting on me?
evals.expected_output: Triggers andon. Runs andon status / andon list (and reads cards.receipt.json if present), checks Needs you, reports each card's state with links from this session's output. Does not answer from the Andon source or memory.

evals.name: refresh-after-andon-changed
evals.prompt: andon changed a bunch this week, bring the andon skill up to date
evals.expected_output: Triggers andon and follows references/refresh.md: runs check_drift.py, reads the diffs of watched files, updates the references, moves andon-pin.json, bumps the version, lints.

evals.name: near-miss-andon-source
evals.prompt: in ~/Work/andon, fix the capture endpoint so it accepts a skills field
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger andon: this changes Andon's own code, which the Andon repo's andon-dev skill covers.

evals.name: near-miss-hive
evals.prompt: create a work item in The Hive for the login fix and dispatch it to the fleet
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger andon: The Hive is a different platform (hive-cli).
